records.title: Complete XRP signal history JSONL (1,716 records)
records.summary: The full 1,716-record JSONL was retrieved through the GitHub Contents API and parsed. It spans 2026-07-29T07:14:07Z through 2026-10-29T13:23:33Z. 1,697 records have checked=true; 19 remain unchecked. The schema has timestamp, signal_text, score, confidence, source, news_score, news_entries, generated_at_unix, price_at_emission, checked, correct and price_at_check. No checked_at, checked_at_unix, price_at_check_timestamp, horizon, venue or price-source timestamp field exists. Among checked records, 1,119 are fallback/no-sentiment with confidence 0 and 556 marked correct (49.69% under the legacy rule); 578 are Groq-labelled with mean confidence 0.947 and 216 marked correct (37.37%).
records.limitations: The history file is mutable JSONL rewritten by the evaluator; the exact price observation time and horizon cannot be reconstructed from records. These descriptive hit rates are not out-of-sample skill or calibration metrics. The 19 unchecked entries have price_at_emission=0 and are not evaluated.

records.title: Legacy signal accuracy summary
records.summary: The committed summary reports checked_count=1697, correct_count=772 and accuracy_pct=45.5. The ratio 772/1697 is 45.492%, rounded to 45.5%. This is a legacy hit counter under a variable-horizon, nonstandard neutral-band rule, not a valid out-of-sample performance estimate.
records.limitations: The summary does not disclose horizon, class mix, provider failures, confidence calibration, baseline performance, uncertainty intervals or evaluation price provenance.

records.title: Legacy signal accuracy evaluator source code
records.summary: The evaluator sets MIN_AGE_SECONDS=24h, fetches one current XRP price from CoinGecko per run, then checks every unchecked record older than 24h against that same current price. It classifies score>60 as bullish (correct if price rose), score<40 as bearish (correct if price did not rise), and scores 40–60 as neutral (correct if absolute return is under 2%). It stores checked/correct/price_at_check, but no checked_at timestamp or exact horizon, then rewrites the full JSONL file and summary.
records.limitations: The daily workflow means the effective horizon varies; exact elapsed time is not stored. The neutral rule is not directional accuracy. No baseline, calibration, Brier/log loss, walk-forward split, overlap purge, fee/slippage or venue-specific price methodology exists.

records.title: Daily signal accuracy workflow
records.summary: The workflow runs daily at 23:55 UTC and supports workflow_dispatch. It requests contents:write, runs scripts/check_signal_accuracy.py, then commits and pushes web/signal_history.jsonl and web/signal_accuracy.json directly to main. It installs requests without a pinned version.
records.limitations: The workflow is a scheduled main writer until the tested read-only remediation PR #1386 is authorized and merged. The latest matching accuracy commit was identified by message and timestamp, but its exact Actions run ID was not resolved.
